name: search_github_plugins
description: Search public GitHub repositories for an existing eisy/IoX/NuCore/Polyglot plugin implementation, or for a device's own API client, once the NuCore store has no viable match. A fallback-tier tool, callable in any order relative to search_web/Claude's own native web search -- not a required first step. Returns repositories with their license and last-updated date; a repository whose license isn't on the permissive allowlist (MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD) is flagged and must never be copied from, only read for reference. Capped at a small number of calls per session.

query.description: GitHub search query, e.g. 'eisy pool controller plugin' or the device/service name plus 'api client'.
